title: Building Prototypes Dan Gelbart  part 10 of 18  Flexures
summary: Part 10 of Dan Gelbart's prototype-building lecture series, covering flexures: flexible joints that give precise, frictionless motion. It shows how a cheap piece of aluminum can become a nanometer-accurate mechanism.
why: HN recommends the series as a fascinating, practical course in precision prototyping, with the flexure episode singled out as especially impressive.

quote.text: He starts off with a $10 piece of aluminum that took maybe an hour or two to make
